choose.when: SELECT u.id, u.username, u.nickname, u.created_at, p.height_cm, p.weight_kg, p.timezone, p.goal, p.preferences, p.ai_consent, p.ai_sleep, p.ai_activity, p.ai_weight, p.ai_heart_rate, p.ai_diary FROM profiles p JOIN users u ON u.id=p.user_id WHERE p.user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY u.id
SELECT kind, content FROM user_preferences WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY kind

SELECT id, start_time, end_time, sleep_date, duration_minutes, source_name, note, source_app, device_brand, device_type, device_model, corrected, created_at FROM sleep_records WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY id
SELECT id, start_time, end_time, activity_date, steps, mode, source_name, note, created_at FROM step_records WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY id
SELECT id, exercise_type, start_time, end_time, activity_date, duration_minutes, source_name, note, plan_item_id, created_at FROM workout_records WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY id

SELECT id, consumed_at, meal_type, food_name, portion_amount, portion_unit, calorie_mode, calories_kcal, reference_amount, reference_calories_kcal, nutrition_source, source_name, note, created_at, updated_at FROM meal_records WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY id
SELECT id, consumed_at, amount_ml, source_name, note, created_at, updated_at FROM water_records WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY id
SELECT id, measured_at, weight_kg, source_name, note, created_at, updated_at FROM weight_records WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY id
SELECT id, measured_at, bpm, source_name, note, corrected FROM heart_rate_samples WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY id
SELECT id, recorded_at, mood, stress_level, body_feeling, events, tags, note, source_name, agent_allowed, created_at, updated_at FROM diary_entries WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY id
SELECT daily_steps FROM activity_goals WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY user_id
SELECT start_date, target_date, target_weight_kg, source_name, created_at, updated_at FROM weight_goals WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY user_id

SELECT id, kind, goal, status, start_date, end_date, plan_start_date, plan_end_date, source_name, include_diary, answer, question, error, statistics_json, draft_json, pending_input, plan_id, report_id, template_id, template_version, confirmed_at, feedback, feedback_at, created_at, updated_at FROM agent_tasks WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY created_at,id
SELECT s.id, s.task_id, s.name, s.status, s.input_summary, s.output_summary, s.created_at FROM agent_steps s JOIN agent_tasks t ON t.id=s.task_id WHERE t.user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY s.id
SELECT id, task_id, title, reason, start_date, end_date, status, version, created_at FROM plans WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY id
SELECT r.plan_id, r.version, r.status, r.note, r.content_json, r.created_at FROM plan_revisions r JOIN plans p ON p.id=r.plan_id WHERE p.user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY r.plan_id,r.version
SELECT s.id, s.plan_id, s.previous_status, s.status, s.changed_at FROM plan_status_changes s JOIN plans p ON p.id=s.plan_id WHERE p.user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY s.id
SELECT i.id, i.plan_id, i.date, i.time, i.title, i.description, i.reminder_time, i.retired, i.missed_reason FROM plan_items i JOIN plans p ON p.id=i.plan_id WHERE p.user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY i.id
SELECT c.id, c.item_id, c.date, c.checked_at FROM checkins c JOIN plan_items i ON i.id=c.item_id JOIN plans p ON p.id=i.plan_id WHERE p.user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY c.id

SELECT id, task_id, title, start_date, end_date, source_name, include_diary, content, statistics_json, references_json, source_deleted, report_type, report_version, metric, comparison_start_date, comparison_end_date, created_at FROM reports WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY id

SELECT id, status, import_format, source_app, device_brand, device_type, device_model, total_rows, valid_rows, invalid_rows, duplicate_rows, skipped_rows, unsupported_rows, inserted_rows, created_at FROM import_batches WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY id
SELECT id, status, total_rows, valid_rows, invalid_rows, duplicate_rows, inserted_rows, created_at FROM step_import_batches WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY id
SELECT id, metric, status, total_rows, duplicate_rows, inserted_rows, first_measurement, last_measurement, created_at, confirmed_at FROM measurement_import_batches WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY id
SELECT id, kind, title, body, target, data_cutoff, created_at, read_at FROM notifications WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY id
SELECT checkin_enabled, checkin_frequency, daily_time, plan_due_enabled, report_enabled, data_change_enabled, import_failed_enabled FROM notification_settings WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY user_id
SELECT weekly_enabled, monthly_enabled, import_enabled, import_days, source_name, notify_in_app FROM agent_trigger_settings WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY user_id
SELECT kind, event_key, start_date, end_date, source_name, task_id, created_at FROM agent_trigger_runs WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY created_at,kind,event_key
SELECT article_id FROM knowledge_favorites WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY article_id
SELECT id, kind, error_code, created_at FROM rejected_imports WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY id
